item.title: Clive Davis Goes In-Depth on His Career, Arista Ouster & More in Interview Taped Last December
item.description:
[Music fades out, and the host begins speaking]
Host: "Welcome to this special episode of 'Trending on Billboard'. Today, we're shining a light on the life and legacy of music executive Clive Davis, who recently passed away. Just a few months before his death, Davis sat down for a rare and candid interview, and we're here to give you a glimpse into that conversation.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "The interview, conducted by former Arista Records executive Rick Bleiweiss, covers Davis' impressive career, from his early days as a corporate lawyer to becoming president of Columbia Records in 1965. Davis shares stories about signing legendary artists like Janis Joplin, Chicago, Bruce Springsteen, and Santana.
[Music transitions to a brief clip of one of the mentioned artists]
Host: "Bleiweiss also gets Davis to open up about his termination from Arista and the subsequent launch of J Records. The conversation is wide-ranging and revealing, offering a unique look into the life of a music industry legend.
[Music returns to the soft background tune]
Host: "The full, nearly 60-minute interview is available to watch, and we'll provide a link for you to check it out. It's a fascinating look into the career of Clive Davis, and we're grateful to have had the chance to share it with you. Thanks for tuning in to this special episode of 'Trending on Billboard'."
[Music fades out, and the host speaks one last time]
Host: "To watch the full interview, follow the link in our show notes. We'll be back with more music news and stories soon."
